propositions: Reconciler has no mechanism to choose between backends; vendor is implicit in module imports
Backend selection infrastructure must be added (config key, registry, select_backend entry point) without rewiring existing consumers (_load_acli, AcliClient construction, differ/apply)
Config-driven backend selection via new reconciler.backend field on ReconcilerConfig with _as_choice validation and REBAR_RECONCILER_BACKEND env override
Registry uses decorator pattern (@register) with lazy import of adapters package and idempotent registration; unknown backend keys raise registry error
select_backend(config) reads config.reconciler.backend and returns Backend; default returns JiraBackend with AcliClient from same resolve_jira_settings() as today
Test-only _reset_registry_for_test context manager allows FakeBackend registration without leaking process state
